article_title: Urine test can spot more than nine in 10 bladder cancers

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: An NHS trial of an at-home urine test that may help detect and rule out bladder cancer
A new operation that completely replaces every bladder examination
A campaign to stop genetic research into cancer
A survey of hospital waiting times for all diseases
tasks.correct_answer: An NHS trial of an at-home urine test that may help detect and rule out bladder cancer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בניסוי של בדיקת שתן ביתית שמראה יכולת מבטיחה לזהות סרטן שלפוחית השתן ולשלול אותו.

tasks.prompt: How large was the study described in the article?
options: About 300 patients at one hospital
Nearly 1,000 patients at seven hospitals in England and Scotland
More than 300,000 patients across Europe
Exactly 450 patients at 23 hospitals
tasks.correct_answer: Nearly 1,000 patients at seven hospitals in England and Scotland
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקר כלל כמעט אלף מטופלים בשבעה בתי חולים באנגליה ובסקוטלנד.

tasks.prompt: What did a negative Galeas test result indicate?
options: The patient definitely needed immediate surgery
The test had found one of 23 genes
There was more than a 99% chance the patient did not have bladder cancer
The patient was among the 8% of missed cases
tasks.correct_answer: There was more than a 99% chance the patient did not have bladder cancer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי תוצאות הניסוי, תשובה שלילית פירושה הסתברות של יותר מ־99% שאין למטופל סרטן בשלפוחית השתן.

tasks.prompt: Why could the urine test reduce pressure on cystoscopy waiting lists without replacing cystoscopies?
options: It can cure cancer before any examination
It is performed only after a cystoscopy
It removes the need to investigate blood in urine
It may help doctors prioritise higher-risk patients for urgent invasive checks
tasks.correct_answer: It may help doctors prioritise higher-risk patients for urgent invasive checks
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הבדיקה אינה מחליפה ציסטוסקופיה, אך היא עשויה לעזור לזהות מי בסיכון גבוה וזקוק לבדיקה פולשנית דחופה יותר.

tasks.prompt: What does “invasive procedures” mean in the description of cystoscopies?
options: Procedures involving instruments entering the body
Tests based only on a written questionnaire
Treatments that are always performed at home
Research studies involving many hospitals
tasks.correct_answer: Procedures involving instruments entering the body
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הליך invasive הוא הליך שבו מכשיר נכנס לגוף; בציסטוסקופיה מוחדרת מצלמה דרך השופכה לשלפוחית השתן.

tasks.prompt: What does “genetic material shed into the urine” mean?
options: DNA that has been deliberately added to a sample
Genes that disappear after treatment
Genetic material released by cancer cells and found in urine
A list of family medical histories
tasks.correct_answer: Genetic material released by cancer cells and found in urine
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה shed פירושו חומר גנטי שמשתחרר מתאי הסרטן ומגיע אל השתן.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the Galeas test works and report its main performance results.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר מה הבדיקה מחפשת ולציין במדויק את שני נתוני הביצועים המרכזיים.
expected_points: It examines an at-home urine sample
It searches for genetic material released by bladder cancer
It checks more than 450 DNA mutations
The mutations are associated with bladder cancer across 23 genes
It identified 92% of bladder cancer cases in the NHS trial
A negative result gave more than a 99% chance that the patient did not have bladder cancer

tasks.prompt: Why do researchers describe the findings as promising but still say further research is needed?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג הן את הראיות המעודדות והן את הסיבות לזהירות, בלי לטעון שהבדיקה כבר החליפה את השיטה הקיימת.
expected_points: The test detected 92% of cases
A negative result was highly reliable in the trial
The study involved nearly 1,000 real-world patients
The test could reduce unnecessary urgent invasive procedures
The findings are still described as early performance
A larger trial must succeed before wider use
The test is not currently a replacement for cystoscopy
Further research is needed to confirm effectiveness

tasks.prompt: Summarise the purpose, method, results and possible impact of the urine-test trial.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מטרת הבדיקה, אוכלוסיית המחקר, אופן הפעולה, הנתונים העיקריים והשפעה אפשרית על המטופלים.
expected_points: The NHS has trialled an at-home urine test for bladder cancer
Nearly 1,000 patients took part at seven hospitals
The test searches for cancer-related DNA mutations in urine
It identified 92% of bladder cancer cases
A negative result meant more than a 99% chance of no bladder cancer
It could help prioritise high-risk patients for cystoscopy
It might spare tens of thousands from urgent invasive tests if a larger trial succeeds
It does not replace cystoscopy at present
Early detection and treatment can save lives

tasks.prompt: Write a short patient-friendly explanation of what the test can and cannot currently do.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית פשוטה ומדויקת, לכלול לפחות ארבע עובדות, להסביר את מגבלות הבדיקה ולהימנע מהבטחה לאבחון ודאי.
expected_points: Describe the test as an at-home urine test being trialled by the NHS
Explain that it looks for cancer-related genetic material
State the 92% detection result
Explain the meaning of a negative result
Clarify that it does not replace cystoscopy
Explain that it may help doctors prioritise urgent cases
Mention that a larger trial and further research are needed
Advise that blood in urine is a main symptom mentioned in the article without giving unsupported medical advice
